jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Product Manager to play a key role in shaping the future of our product portfolio. In this role, you will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and leadership, to define and execute the strategy, and roadmap for innovative products that delight our customers and drive business growth. As a Senior Product Manager, you will own the product lifecycle from ideation through launch, ensuring alignment with company goals, customer needs, and market trends. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled product manager with a proven track record of delivering impactful products and driving innovation in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

Organizational Relationships: Interacts with Technology/Engineering, Design/UX, Marketing, Sales/Ops, After-Sales, Analytics, Legal, 3rd party vendors.

This role could be an individual contributor or a manager of people.

At this time, we are not considering applicants who require employment authorization sponsorship (1) as a condition of eligibility for employment with the Company or (2) at any point during the term of their employment. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship by the Company.

Job Responsibilities:
- Own the development, execution, and success of large-scale products or multiple smaller products.
- Successfully manage and deliver multiple projects simultaneously, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
- Independently prioritize features, initiatives, and projects based on customer needs, business value, and technical feasibility.
- Make trade-offs as necessary and set realistic expectations with senior leadership on delivery timeframes.
- Write clear, comprehensive product requirements for projects of any size, ensuring alignment across teams.
- Design A/B tests to measure feature success, analyze results, and determine next steps to optimize product performance.
- Partner with UX teams to define research goals, develop research guides, and synthesize findings to inform future product decisions.
- Establish and monitor KPIs to measure success and ensure accurate tracking of product performance.
- Troubleshoot data issues and work with raw data to derive meaningful insights for continuous improvement.
- Translate business strategies and KPIs into actionable product roadmaps in collaboration with senior product team members.
- Continuously refine and maintain the roadmap in consultation with leadership.
- Demonstrate behaviors consistent with the Company’s Vision, Mission, and Values in all interactions with customers, co-workers, and suppliers.
- Adheres to all company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Qualifications:
- 5 to 8 years of experience in product management or equivalent roles, demonstrating a track record of successful product ownership and delivery.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities with a data-driven approach to decision-making.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills, capable of influencing stakeholders across various levels.
- Expertise in A/B testing methodologies and deriving actionable insights.
- Ability to work with qualitative and quantitative data to drive product decisions.
- Experience developing and maintaining strategic product roadmaps.
- Proficiency in product management tools such as Jira, Confluence, and analytics platforms.
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field is preferred.
- Must meet company’s requirements for employment.

Next Possible Position: Principal Product Manager, or Group Product Manager

Physical Requirements:
- Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer
- Frequent use of hands and fingers for typing, writing, and handling office equipment.
- Ability to use a computer monitor and read small text for extended periods.
- Occasional standing and walking within the office for meetings or collaboration.
- Lifting or carrying light objects such as laptops, office supplies, or documents (typically up to 10–15 lbs).
- Clear verbal communication for phone calls, virtual meetings, and in-person discussions.
- Ability to focus in an open office environment or while using noise-canceling devices.
- Occasional bending, reaching, or crouching to access filing cabinets or office storage.
- Minimal travel (if applicable) for training, meetings, or company events.

Compensation Disclaimer
Base Salary: $138,000 to $184,000.00 base salary, commensurate with experience, qualifications, and geographic location. This position is also eligible for an annual performance-based bonus and RSUs in accordance with the company's applicable incentive plan.

jobs.title: Analyst, Product Operations
jobs.description:
The Analyst, Product Operations supports the day-to-day execution and upkeep of our OEM tier 3 websites and sales enablement systems. This role manages assigned requests, operational issues, and smaller digital initiatives from intake through completion, ensuring work is accurately interpreted, investigated, prioritized, executed, validated, and resolved.

Working closely with Product Operations leadership, OEM partners, website vendors, sales enablement systems and internal field teams, this individual is expected to take ownership of assigned work, independently gather and assess relevant information, identify appropriate next steps, and drive issues and initiatives toward resolution while escalating risks or complex decisions when appropriate.

This is a detail-oriented, hands-on role that requires strong analytical thinking, initiative, follow-through, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across a complex digital ecosystem.
Organization Relationships: Partners cross-functionally with:

Product Operations leadership

Product team

Sales Operations

Marketing

Pricing and Inventory teams

Technology

Field teams

External coordination includes:

OEM website vendors

Third-party platform providers

Sales enablement and other digital technology partners

At this time, we are not considering applicants who require employment authorization sponsorship (1) as a condition of eligibility for employment with the Company or (2) at any point during the term of their employment. Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future visa sponsorship by the Company.

Job responsibilities:
- Execute website content updates across OEM tier 3 sites, ensuring accuracy and compliance with OEM guidelines.

- Monitor, triage, investigate, and resolve issues and field requests.  Interpret requests, gather relevant information, troubleshoot potential causes, determine appropriate next steps, engage the necessary internal teams or external partners, and follow issues through validation and closure.

- Coordinate assigned digital initiatives rollouts from planning through completion, including defining requirements and next steps, coordinating stakeholders, managing timelines and dependencies, identifying risks and opportunities, validating implementation, and communicating status and outcomes.

- Support governance of domain portfolio by tracking renewals, ownership records, and alignment with brand requirements. Coordinate DNS updates and partner with vendors to monitor and enforce brand protection.

- Maintain reporting dashboards and trackers related to site performance, open issues, and program rollouts.

- Ensure changes are implemented accurately and consistently across multiple sites and platforms, validating completed work against requirements.

- Ensure adherence to compliance requirements (OEM standards, legal disclaimers, privacy/cookie tools, ADA considerations, etc.).

- Maintain documentation of website standards, processes, system requirements, and workflows (e.g, Azure DevOps).

- Demonstrate behaviors consistent with the Company’s Vision, Mission, and Values in all interactions with customers, co-workers, and suppliers.

- Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Business, Technology, Marketing, or related field (or equivalent experience).

- 2–5 years of experience in digital operations, website management, content management, or a related field.

- Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with clear ownership of issues through resolution.

- Familiarity with CRM systems and SaaS platforms, with working knowledge of Content Management Systems (CMS) and basic HTML preferred.

- Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple requests and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Clear written and verbal communication skills.

- Comfortable working across internal teams and external partners.

- Experience in automotive retail or multi-location businesses is a plus.

- Must meet company’s requirements for employment.

- Valid in-state driver’s license and ability to maintain an acceptable, safe driving record.

jobs.title: Digital Product Analyst
jobs.description:
The Digital Product Analyst will support the digital product, marketing channel, and operations teams with a focus on conversational intelligence, inbound call tracking, and marketing analytics. This role will help manage campaign tracking and engagement, support acquisitions and new locations, develop custom reporting, and coordinate field requests that improve visibility into marketing performance. This role reports directly to the Sr. Product Owner of Call Tracking & Conversation Intelligence and works closely with marketing analytics, marketing channel, and operations teams.

Job Responsibilities:
- Support digital product leadership on projects focused on inbound call tracking, conversational intelligence, analytics, and reporting.
- Analyze and report on inbound call KPIs, attribution, and call outcomes to help marketing understand campaign performance and assist operations teams optimize inbound call handling.
- Maintain data quality, integrity, and standardization across marketing attribution data by conducting regular audits, identifying discrepancies, and performing necessary data remediation.
- Manage conversational intelligence related tasks such as AI signal development and training, model accuracy auditing, performance monitoring, and optimization.
- Maintain and update marketing attribution data configurations, processes, SOPs, and best practices documentation to ensure consistency, accuracy, and operational efficiency.
- Manage marketing phone number provisioning, Interactive Voice Response systems (IVR) building, and related marketing data for existing and new locations.
- Help oversee pilots and integration of AI agents, including voice and SMS experiences, into call flows and configure outcome-based tracking.
- Effectively communicate backlog requests progress with stakeholders and ensure SLAs are met.
- Manage and maintain call alerts and network outage monitoring systems, while coordinating resolution with internal and external teams.
- Support acquisitions, divestitures, new store openings, and organizational changes by updating call tracking, marketing attribution, phone numbers, IVR configurations, and related system mappings.

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree or equivalent work experience.
- Two or more years of marketing, data management, reporting, or marketing analytics experience.
- Intermediate proficiency utilizing enterprise AI platforms (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot) to design prompts, analyze unstructured data, and generate business insights.
- Must be detail-oriented and data-driven.
- Proficient in Microsoft Office applications particularly in Excel.
- Familiarity with marketing analytics, web analytics, CRM, call tracking, or attribution platforms is preferred.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously, prioritize workload effectively, and thrive in a dynamic environment.
- Goal-oriented with strong organizational and problem-solving skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, cross-team environment.
- Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain data insights to internal stakeholders.
- Experience with inbound call tracking and analytics platforms/vendors is preferred.
- Automotive industry knowledge preferred.
